data.body: Recurring git blockage in C:\src\Aworkit: the running Aworkit desktop app rewrites the Adashi-generated architecture block inside tracked files (agents.md, **/AGENTS.md, docs/AGENTS.md) and .adashi/local/markdown-projection.json from its live design store. Those paths are exactly what upstream commits also touch, so `git pull` aborts with "Your local changes to the following files would be overwritten by merge" plus untracked collisions (docs/adashi/, three generated AGENTS.md). Verified 2026-09-29: every such local edit lies strictly inside the adashi:architecture:begin/end block, so nothing hand-authored is at risk; the design store under .adashi/text is the source of truth. Resolution used: `git stash push -u` (keeps a recoverable backup), then `git pull --ff-only`, then optionally `git stash drop`. Expect the tree to go dirty again seconds after any checkout, because the app regenerates the blocks.
